notes: Matched DINOv2 front-end versus StreamVGGT aggregated features from the same existing frozen checkpoint; not a reproduction of published DINOv3 or EUPE V-RAE results.
Same accepted RGB windows, C256 token grid, video decoder and fresh generator initialization; no independent RGB texture branch or future controls.
Input feature widths differ and projector parameter counts must be reported; equal downstream shape does not imply equal encoder compute.
Fixed training-set and development-set free generation are both required. The reused 64 cases are development data, not a new publication test set.
All step counts are bounded experiment budgets, not evidence of convergence or guaranteed visual quality.
Existing historical Gaussian decoder adaptation remains a prior experiment; this run compares representation sources within a new shared codec.
